lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，慢慢接近玩家
lines.en: Sibilant, creeping towards the player

lines.zh: 挥舞着苍白的手臂，试图抓住玩家
lines.en: Swinging pale arms, trying to grab the player

lines.zh: 摇摆着头，寻找食物
lines.en: Shaking head, searching for food

lines.zh: 慢慢移动，警惕地注视四周
lines.en: Moving slowly, cautiously looking around

lines.zh: 蹒跚着前行，发出微弱的呢喃
lines.en: Stumbling forward, whispering faintly

lines.zh: 张开干瘪的嘴巴，试图咬住玩家
lines.en: Opening dry mouth, trying to bite the player

lines.zh: 低头寻找地面的腐肉
lines.en: Bending down to search for rotting flesh

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，眼睛闪烁着绿色光芒
lines.en: Moving slowly, green eyes glowing

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，表明它在思考
lines.en: Issuing low hiss, indicating it's thinking

lines.zh: 慢慢地舔着自己的手，似乎在自舔伤口
lines.en: Slowly licking its own hand, as if cleaning a wound

lines.zh: 贴着墙根溜过去
lines.en: I slip along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 阳光太烈，绕进阴影
lines.en: The sun is harsh; I slip into the shade.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，眼睛盯着地面
lines.en: Standing still, eyes on the ground

lines.zh: 用干枯的手指整理自己的衣服
lines.en: Adjusting clothes with withered fingers

lines.zh: 目光空洞地四处张望
lines.en: Staring aimlessly around

lines.zh: 坐在地上，低垂着头
lines.en: Sitting on the ground, head hanging

lines.zh: 缓慢地摇摆着身体，似乎在等待
lines.en: Shaking body slowly, waiting

lines.zh: 轻声呢喃，似乎在自言自语
lines.en: Whispering softly, to himself

lines.zh: 双手交叉放在胸前，显得很疲惫
lines.en: Crossing arms over chest, looking weary

lines.zh: 在原地踱步，似乎在寻找什么东西
lines.en: Pacing, as if searching for something

lines.zh: 轻轻挥动手臂，似乎在试图唤醒什么
lines.en: Swinging arms, as if trying to awaken something

lines.zh: 偶尔低声自语，但很快又沉默下来
lines.en: Occasionally muttering, but quickly falls silent

lines.zh: 突然抬起头，盯着玩家
lines.en: Suddenly looks up, staring at the player

lines.zh: 向玩家方向转动脑袋，眼神空洞
lines.en: Turning head towards the player, eyes vacant

lines.zh: 快速转动脖子，寻找玩家的身影
lines.en: Quickly turning neck, looking for the player

lines.zh: 目光从玩家身上移开，又回到地面
lines.en: Eyes move from player to the ground

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，试图确定威胁
lines.en: Staring at the player, trying to assess threat

lines.zh: 瞪大眼睛，盯着玩家，然后缓缓转头
lines.en: Bolting eyes towards player, then slowly turning head

lines.zh: 目光聚焦在玩家身上，随后再次分散
lines.en: Eyes focus on player, then drift away

lines.zh: 看向玩家，似乎在犹豫是否袭击
lines.en: Looking at the player, deciding whether to attack

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，似乎在思考下一步
lines.en: Eyes flicker, contemplating next move

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，低垂的头颅突然抬起
lines.en: Staring at the player, head suddenly lifting

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，缓缓倒下。
lines.en: Yushiro is wounded and falls slowly.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了些伤，虚弱地站着。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, standing weakly.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，蹒跚前行。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, staggering forward.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，痛苦地嘶吼。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, howling in pain.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，发出低沉的呻吟。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, groaning lowly.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，踉跄地退后。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, staggering back.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，缓缓倒在地上。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, falling to the ground.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，无力地挣扎。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, struggling weakly.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，痛苦地咆哮。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt, roaring in pain.

lines.zh: 愈史郎受了伤，虚弱地摇晃。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt,摇晃 weakly.

lines.zh: 饥渴难耐，想要品尝你的鲜血！
lines.en: Hunger drives me to taste your blood!

lines.zh: 你身上的味道引来了我的注意！
lines.en: Your scent calls to me.

lines.zh: 我的力量来自于你的痛苦！
lines.en: My power comes from your pain.

lines.zh: 与我同归于尽吧，永生在即！
lines.en: Perish with me, eternal life awaits!

lines.zh: 你的恐惧给了我力量！
lines.en: Your fear fuels me!

lines.zh: 靠近我，让我的血液流淌！
lines.en: Come closer, let my blood flow.

lines.zh: 你是我下一个猎物！
lines.en: You're my next victim.

lines.zh: 你递来的血，我先闻了闻。
lines.en: I sniff the blood you offer before taking it.

lines.zh: 你的血，不如珠世大人的。
lines.en: Your blood is nothing next to Lady Tamayo's.

lines.zh: 我是不死之身，永生的象征！
lines.en: I am the embodiment of eternal life.

lines.zh: 阳光下，我的存在显而易见！
lines.en: Sunlight reveals my presence.

lines.zh: 躲开阳光，否则你将被消灭！
lines.en: Avoid the sun, or you'll be destroyed!

lines.zh: 你阻挡了我的道路，准备战斗！
lines.en: You block my path, prepare to fight!

lines.zh: 你的存在威胁到了我！
lines.en: Your presence endangers me!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞激起了我的怒火！
lines.en: Your collision angers me!

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我袖子里的血术亮了。
lines.en: You bump me, and the blood art in my sleeve glows.

lines.zh: 阳光下，你无处可藏！
lines.en: In the sun, you have nowhere to hide!

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的去路，必须清除！
lines.en: You block my way, must be cleared!

lines.zh: 你的干扰让我无法前进！
lines.en: Your interference blocks my path!

lines.zh: 我的存在不容挑战！
lines.en: My presence cannot be challenged!

lines.zh: 与我交配，共同创造不死之灵！
lines.en: Mate with me, create an undying spirit!

lines.zh: 你是我理想的伴侣，让我们结合！
lines.en: You are my perfect mate, let's unite!

lines.zh: 与我结合，成为不死的眷侣！
lines.en: Unite with me, become an eternal couple!

lines.zh: 让我们的灵魂永生不灭！
lines.en: Let our souls be eternal!

lines.zh: 我的血液将注入你的身体！
lines.en: My blood flows into you!

lines.zh: 与我交配，共享不死之力！
lines.en: Mate with me, share the power of immortality!

lines.zh: 你的灵魂将与我融合！
lines.en: Your soul will merge with mine!

lines.zh: 让我们一起永恒存在！
lines.en: Let's exist eternally together!

lines.zh: 与我结合，永生不再遥远！
lines.en: Unite with me, immortality is near!

lines.zh: 你的存在让我更有力量！
lines.en: Your presence strengthens me!

lines.zh: 滴溜溜转眼珠，吸取你灵魂！
lines.en: Roll eyes and drain your soul!

lines.zh: 饥渴的双眼盯着你，愈史郎来了！
lines.en: Hungry eyes on you, Yushiro comes!

lines.zh: 吸血鬼之吻，灵魂归我！
lines.en: Vampire's kiss, soul mine!

lines.zh: 血鬼术启动，灵魂摇曳！
lines.en: Blood magic active, soul swaying!

lines.zh: 你就是我的新灵魂食粮！
lines.en: You're my new soul snack!

lines.zh: 滴答滴答，灵魂的滴答声！
lines.en: Tick tock, soul's tick tock!

lines.zh: 灵魂之灯，为你而燃！
lines.en: Soul lantern, for you!

lines.zh: 愈史郎来了，灵魂受苦！
lines.en: Yushiro comes, soul suffers!

lines.zh: 黑暗中吸取你的灵魂！
lines.en: Soul drain in the dark!

lines.zh: 魂归深渊，灵魂吞噬！
lines.en: Soul into abyss, devour!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，愈史郎抓你！
lines.en: You can't escape, Yushiro got you!

lines.zh: 血鬼术启动，瞄准猎物！
lines.en: Blood magic active, target acquired!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的视线，锁定目标！
lines.en: Yushiro's gaze, target locked!

lines.zh: 灵魂的呼唤，愈史郎找你！
lines.en: Soul's call, Yushiro seeks!

lines.zh: 血之渴望，愈史郎追踪！
lines.en: Blood craving, Yushiro tracks!

lines.zh: 灵魂的味道，愈史郎闻到！
lines.en: Soul's scent, Yushiro detects!

lines.zh: 愈史郎来了，灵魂颤抖！
lines.en: Yushiro comes, soul quivers!

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找，愈史郎发现！
lines.en: Darkness reveals, Yushiro finds!

lines.zh: 灵魂的气息，愈史郎感知！
lines.en: Soul's aura, Yushiro senses!

lines.zh: 愈史郎追踪，灵魂哀鸣！
lines.en: Yushiro tracks, soul wails!

lines.zh: 珠世大人说过，不能放你走
lines.en: Lady Tamayo said you must not leave.

lines.zh: 你身上血腥味很重
lines.en: The smell of blood on you is heavy.

lines.zh: 纸符一扬，看见的都不真
lines.en: Talismans rise; nothing you see is real.

lines.zh: 别乱动，术已经发动
lines.en: Do not move. The art is already cast.

lines.zh: 你走错了地方
lines.en: You have come to the wrong place.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的尖牙，即将咬碎！
lines.en: Yushiro's fangs, soon to bite!

lines.zh: 灵魂要被吸干了！
lines.en: Soul's nearly drained!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的血鬼术，即将发动！
lines.en: Yushiro's blood magic coming!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的吸血之吻，即将降临！
lines.en: Yushiro's vampiric kiss coming!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的黑暗，即将笼罩！
lines.en: Yushiro's darkness descends!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的利爪，即将撕裂！
lines.en: Yushiro's claws, tearing!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的尖牙，即将贯穿！
lines.en: Yushiro's fangs, piercing!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的黑暗力量，即将吞噬！
lines.en: Yushiro's dark force, devouring!

lines.zh: 愈史郎的吸血之吻，即将吻落！
lines.en: Yushiro's vampiric kiss! Kiss!

lines.zh: 幻术铺开，你的方向错了
lines.en: The illusion spreads; your direction is wrong.

lines.zh: 数三下，你就看不见我
lines.en: Count to three and you will lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 符纸在暗处一张张亮起
lines.en: Talismans light up one by one in the dark.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛已不听使唤
lines.en: Your eyes no longer obey you.

lines.zh: 再往前一步就进我的术
lines.en: One more step and you are inside my art.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子画歪了
lines.en: I have skewed the shape of your shadow.

lines.zh: 记住，这一切都是假的
lines.en: Remember: all of this is false.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步声是假的
lines.en: The footsteps you hear are not real.

lines.zh: 珠世大人看着，我不能失手
lines.en: Lady Tamayo is watching; I must not fail.

lines.zh: 月光被云遮住，正好
lines.en: Clouds cover the moon — perfect timing.

lines.zh: 你眨眼那一刻，我在旁边
lines.en: The moment you blink, I am beside you.

lines.zh: 鬼火在愈史郎周围绕舞。
lines.en: Yoshiro's ghostly aura swirls around him.

lines.zh: 愈史郎发出阴森的呢喃声。
lines.en: Yoshiro mutters darkly.

lines.zh: 愈史郎紧握利刃，准备攻击。
lines.en: Yoshiro clutches his blade, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的影子在月光下拉长。
lines.en: Yoshiro's shadow lengthens under moonlight.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的攻击带有寒气。
lines.en: Yoshiro's attack is icy.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的血液如同液体宝石。
lines.en: Yoshiro's blood glows like liquid gems.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的鬼火在夜晚中闪烁。
lines.en: Yoshiro's ghostly flames flicker in the night.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的喉咙发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Yoshiro hisses.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的攻击如影随形。
lines.en: Yoshiro's attacks follow you.

lines.zh: 愈史郎的刀刃反射月光。
lines.en: Yoshiro's blade glints in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 指甲划开你的衣袖
lines.en: My nails tear open your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从你背后伸手
lines.en: I reach out from behind you.

lines.zh: 一记短促的掌击
lines.en: A short, sharp palm strike.

lines.zh: 你看见的我在左边
lines.en: The me you see is on your left.

lines.zh: 符纸割过你的手背
lines.en: A talisman slices across your hand.

lines.zh: 抓住你手腕用力一拧
lines.en: I seize your wrist and twist.

lines.zh: 幻影先出，真身随后
lines.en: The phantom goes first, the real body after.

lines.zh: 贴着你耳朵低语一句
lines.en: I whisper one line by your ear.

lines.zh: 愈史郎从黑暗中浮现。
lines.en: Yoshiro materializes from the darkness.

lines.zh: 愈史郎在阴影中现身。
lines.en: Yoshiro appears in the shadows.

lines.zh: 愈史郎从破碎的墓碑中走出。
lines.en: Yoshiro steps out from a broken tombstone.

lines.zh: 愈史郎在坟地里缓缓现身。
lines.en: Yoshiro slowly emerges from the graveyard.

lines.zh: 愈史郎从地下突现。
lines.en: Yoshiro pops out of the ground.

lines.zh: 愈史郎在夜晚中出现。
lines.en: Yoshiro appears at night.

lines.zh: 愈史郎从雾中走出。
lines.en: Yoshiro steps out from the mist.

lines.zh: 愈史郎从密林深处走出。
lines.en: Yoshiro emerges from the dense forest.

lines.zh: 愈史郎在荒废的村庄出现。
lines.en: Yoshiro appears in the abandoned village.

lines.zh: 愈史郎在月光下现身。
lines.en: Yoshiro appears in moonlight.

lines.zh: 从墙里的阴影渗出来
lines.en: I seep out of the shadow in the wall.

lines.zh: 符纸一张张在身边落定
lines.en: Talismans settle around me one by one.

lines.zh: 避开阳光，藏在屋檐下
lines.en: Out of the sun, tucked under the eaves.

lines.zh: 珠世大人的宅邸多了影子
lines.en: Another shadow joins Lady Tamayo's house.

lines.zh: 愈史郎躲开了火焰的攻击。
lines.en: Yushiro dodges the fire attack.

lines.zh: 愈史郎从高处摔下，发出惨叫。
lines.en: Yushiro falls from a high place, screaming.

lines.zh: 愈史郎在水中挣扎，快要溺水。
lines.en: Yushiro struggles in the water, nearly drowning.

lines.zh: 愈史郎被爆炸震伤，踉跄倒地。
lines.en: Yushiro is injured by the explosion, staggering to the ground.

lines.zh: 愈史郎被飞射的箭伤到，痛苦哀嚎。
lines.en: Yushiro is hurt by a projectile, howling in pain.

lines.zh: 愈史郎被咒术伤到，倒地抽搐。
lines.en: Yushiro is injured by magic, twitching on the ground.

lines.zh: 愈史郎因饥饿而虚弱，摇摇欲坠。
lines.en: Yushiro is weak from hunger, teetering.

lines.zh: 愈史郎被闪电击中，颤抖倒地。
lines.en: Yushiro is struck by lightning, trembling on the ground.

lines.zh: 愈史郎跌入虚无，发出惨烈的哀嚎。
lines.en: Yushiro falls into the void, emitting a terrible scream.
